long_biography.plain_text:
OmniAccess began as a Palma IT support team serving the unusual connectivity demands of vessels moving beyond shore-based networks. Hartman approached that problem as an engineer: the company built Wi-Fi and WiMAX services, moved into satellite broadband, and put its first teleport into service in 2009.

Controlling infrastructure became a defining operating choice. OmniAccess ran its own teleports and network operations centre, letting engineers manage coverage, bandwidth and support end to end. Satellite-operator partnerships extended that model to remote routes. After Marlink acquired the company in 2018, OmniAccess continued under its own brand inside the larger group.
